item.g:title: U Shaped Pregnancy Pillow
item.g:description: Premium 200 Thread-Count Washable Cover Included (12ft / 365cm) • Total Length: 12ft (365cm) • Each Leg: 72" (182cm) • Width: 16" (40cm) For all of us mums-to-be: we know how exhausting the aches and pains can be. Aching hips, lower back strain, restless legs, and bump pressure make finding a comfortable sleeping position nearly impossible. If you’re tired of tossing and turning all night and waking up exhausted, our Total Body Pregnancy Pillow was designed specifically for you! Why is it so effective? It’s simple: Unlike ordinary pillows that shift during the night, our ergonomic U-shaped design contours around your entire body to cradle your back, hips, knees, and bump simultaneously. It gently aligns your spine and relieves pressure on your major joints, giving you the deep, restorative rest you need. THE COSY FEATURES: Ergonomically Contoured: The full 12ft U-shape wraps around your body from head to toe, helping you maintain a comfortable, safe side-sleeping position throughout all trimesters. Helps Relieve Joint & Back Pain: Provides targeted cushioning for your lower back, pelvis, and hips, reducing nighttime tossing and easing daily fatigue. Cosy & Snuggly Comfort: Generously filled with premium hypoallergenic bounceback hollowfibre and wrapped in a breathable, soft cotton-blend cover. Massively Versatile: Perfect for side sleeping, but also ideal for reading in bed, elevating swollen legs, and nursing or bottle-feeding your newborn once baby arrives. SPECIFICATIONS: Shape: Ergonomic U-Shape Total Length: Approx. 365cm / 12ft (182cm / 6ft per side) Width: Approx. 40cm / 16" Filling: 100% Bounceback Hypoallergenic Hollowfibre Cover: Breathable Cotton-Poly Blend (Removable & Machine Washable) Care: Machine washable cover at 40°C, tumble dry low WHAT’S INCLUDED: 1 × Full Body 12ft U-Shaped Pregnancy Pillow 1 × Removable 200 Thread-Count Washable Cover (In your chosen colour)

item.g:title: Wolverhampton Wanderers FC Backpack
item.g:description: The Wolverhampton Wanderers FC Fade Backpack is a compact, everyday bag designed for fans and daily use. The front panel features Wolves text and the club crest on a distinctive fade design, while the main compartment opens via a large double zipper for easy access to belongings. Built from wipe-clean polyester, this backpack includes a padded back panel and adjustable shoulder straps for comfortable wear, plus a carry strap for alternative carrying options. Key features Size: approximately 40 cm x 30 cm x 14 cm Main compartment with a large double zip for straightforward access Front design showcasing Wolves text and club crest 2 mesh side pockets for water bottles or small items Padded back panel and adjustable shoulder straps for comfort Carry strap for alternative grip Wipe-clean polyester construction Packaging: swing tag Use cases and ideal audience This backpack suits students, commuters, and sports fans who want a practical bag with team branding. It fits notebooks, folders, and daily necessities for school or work, while the two mesh side pockets provide convenient storage for a water bottle or accessories. The fade design with Wolves text and crest helps identify the bag with the Wolverhampton Wanderers FC theme without compromising everyday versatility. Ideal for day trips, gym sessions, or weekend activities where a compact carry is sufficient. Practical considerations The bag’s wipe-clean polyester surface supports easy maintenance, and the combination of a padded back panel, adjustable straps, and a carry handle contributes to comfortable all-day wear. The packaging includes a swing tag for presentation without requiring additional wrapping.

item.g:description: The Liverpool FC Hex Size 3 Football is a youth-sized ball designed for players aged 6 to 9 years. It features a multi-color PVC panel construction with 30 panels that display a mix of club logos and text. The ball’s circumference is approximately 63 cm, classed as Size 3, making it suitable for developing ball control and basic techniques during practice or casual games. The multi-color design enhances visibility during play, training drills, and small-sided games, which can support hand-eye coordination and foot skills commonly developed in youth football programs. Use cases and suitability Best suited for informal games and practice sessions with friends or classmates. Suitable for practicing dribbling, passing accuracy, and shooting technique in safe environments like backyards, parks, or gym floors. item.g:title: Arsenal FC Pop Puzzle Game
item.g:description: The Arsenal FC Pop Puzzle Game is a handheld sensory fidget toy designed for children to engage with tactile and cognitive challenges in a compact form. The white game pad features Arsenal red detailing and crest, integrating familiar branding into a portable device. Four play modes provide varied challenges: Stage Mode guides players through a sequence of pops with increasing difficulty, encouraging pattern recognition and timing. Memory Mode tests recall by presenting a sequence that must be reproduced, supporting working memory skills. Scoring Mode records accuracy and speed, allowing players to compare attempts across sessions. Multiplayer Mode enables head-to-head play, promoting turn-taking and social interaction. Design and use: The device is compact (approximately 13.5 cm x 5 cm x 10 cm) and runs on three AAA batteries (not included). It is packaged in a display box for easy shelf presentation and gifting contexts. Practical use cases and who it's for: This handheld toy suits kids during travel, classroom activities, or quiet-time at home. The tactile pop-push buttons produce immediate feedback to help maintain engagement, while the varied modes offer ongoing challenges to extend play. It is well-suited for developing fine motor skills, hand-eye coordination, and concentration in children and for individuals who benefit from sensory input. Use it as a portable focus aid during homework breaks or as a collaborative activity in small-group settings. Compared to screen-based play, the Arsenal FC Pop Puzzle Game provides physical interaction with immediate, repeatable feedback, supporting sustained attention and dexterity without a display-based distraction. The display box packaging helps with organization and presentation in retail settings.

item.g:title: Post-Surgery Hip Abduction Wedge – Leg Separator Pillow with Velcro Straps
item.g:description: This British-made abduction wedge is a firm foam positioning cushion that holds the legs apart in a stable V shape. It is a positioning aid for rest, often used when a consistent leg position has been advised by a healthcare professional. Key specifications Core material: High-density, firm orthopaedic foam for long-lasting structural integrity. Cover fabric: Breathable, multi-stretch waterproof material (soft-touch). Hygiene standards: Cover is machine washable up to 95°C and conforms to BS 7175 Crib 5 fire safety standards (suitable for hospital and nursing home use). Security: Features 4 adjustable hook-and-loop (Velcro) straps to secure the legs comfortably in place. Dimensions: 21" (L) x 24" (W) x 6.5" (H). Manufacturing: Handmade in Devon, UK. Typical uses Consistent leg positioning: holding the legs in an abducted V position during rest. Seated or lying support: keeping the legs apart, including while seated in a wheelchair. Comfort between the legs: reducing skin-on-skin contact and friction while positioned. Care and safety Cleaning: The zipped cover is removable and can be wiped clean with a damp cloth or laundered at high temperatures. Do not wash the foam core.
